snippet.title: Hyperstacks Announcement Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist Hyperstacks on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1046760/Hyperstacks/?utm_source=youtube

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/squirrelbytes

Hyperstacks is a VR challenge experience built around combat, parkour, puzzles, memorable characters, and community-made levels made with the in-game level editor.

Enter a strange floating lobby, meet its residents, and progress through a campaign filled with traps, bosses, and unexpected challenges. As you play, new characters appear, new areas open up, and more of the game begins to unfold.

Beyond the campaign, you can explore a growing library of community-made levels, from combat arenas and puzzle rooms to movement trials and chaotic experiments.

Many of these levels are made with the in-game editor, which lets players create their own stages using enemies, traps, movement tools, puzzles, logic systems, colors, lighting, and more.

Hyperstacks launches in Early Access on {this data will be included after trailer release}

#Hyperstacks #VRGame #IndieGame #Steam
